अड r. 1st cl. (अडति) To strive or endeavour. 5th cl. (अडोति) To occupy
or possess, (peculiar to the Vedas.)

अड्ड r. 1st cl. (अड्डति)
 1. To connect.
 2. To solve, or demonstrate.
 3. To
strive, to endeavour. The radical penultimate is द, and the root
is also written by VOPADEVA, अद्द.

आडम्बर m. (-रः)
 1. Charge sounded by musical instruments.
 2. The
roaring of elephants.
 3. A drum used in battle.
 4.

. The eyelid.
 6. Pride, arrogance.
 7. Anger, passion.
 8. Happi-
ness, pleasure.
 n. (-रं) Rubbing and moulding the body.
 E. आङ्
before दम to tame or subdue, वरच् affix; द is changed to ड.

आडम्बरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Proud, arrogant.
 E. आडम्बर and इनि aff.
